# megooflags_project (Resource)

A project and its environments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "megooflags_project" "shop" {
  key         = "shop"
  name        = "Shop"
  description = "The web shop"

  environments = [
    { key = "dev", name = "Development" },
    { key = "staging", name = "Staging" },
    # Terraform cannot change flags here: changes need a change request.
    { key = "prod", name = "Production", approvals_required = 1 },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environments` (Attributes List) Environments in display order, matched by key. Removing one deletes it and its flag configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `key` (String) Project key. Changing it replaces the project.
- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `stale_after_days` (Number) A flag no environment has evaluated for this many days is stale (1 to 365). The server default is 30.

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Required:

- `key` (String) Environment key.
- `name` (String) Display name.

Optional:

- `approvals_required` (Number) Approvals a change request needs here (0 to 10). Terraform can only change flags in environments with 0.
- `description` (String) Description.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the project key.
terraform import megooflags_project.shop shop
```
